title: docs(organizations): drop the retired orphan claim from the SYSTEM_CTX writer lists
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgULzXHHREefG78bonpN6vqt)_

Fixes #25203
Part of #15212

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this changes

Items 9 and 10 of the card: two comments in `@objectstack/organizations` that still named the retired orphan claim (`claimOrphanOrgRows`) among the legitimate SYSTEM_CTX writers that name another organization. That writer no longer exists, so both lists now name only the writers that do.

- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.ts` (Middleware A, the `isSystem` short-circuit note): "the per-org seed replay, the orphan claim, imports, migrations" becomes "the per-org seed replay, imports, migrations".
- `packages/plugins/organizations/src/organizations-plugin.test.ts` (the comment above the system-context cross-org test): "per-org seed replay / orphan-claim, migrations" becomes "per-org seed replay, migrations".

Comments only: no code, no assertion and no test name moves.

## Why this closes the card

This is the card's last slice. Items 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 8 landed through #25266, and item 4 landed with #25210. Item 5 is a governed `.claude/**` line and has its own carrier, #25276, which remains open and is not addressed here.

## What stays

`git grep -n -i orphan -- packages/plugins/organizations/src` after the edit, every remaining hit and why it stays:

- `organizations-plugin.ts:151` and `:434-435`: they describe the retirement itself ("NO ORPHAN CLAIM", "There used to be a Fallback A"), which is true. Left alone on purpose.
- `first-organization-orphan-rows.pin.test.ts:7`: the suite docblock says `claimOrphanOrgRows` "used to run here" and that the claim is retired. True.
- `first-organization-orphan-rows.pin.test.ts:152-207`: fixture row ids and names (`acc_orphan`, `task_orphan_1`, "Orphan account") for organization-less rows. They name the data shape, not the retired writer.
- `org-scoping-engine.ts:16`: names `OrphanCleanupEngine` in `plugin-sharing`, an unrelated live engine.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations test`: Test Files 16 passed (16), Tests 239 passed (239), lock VERDICT command-exit 0, at `641031d3d`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/organizations typecheck`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, at `641031d3d`.
- The derived local gate list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 56 commands) was run at `641031d3d`; exit codes are in the dispatch report on the card.

## Changeset

None. The diff moves only source comments, which publish nothing, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.
